function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-grounded investigation of the MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign. Reconstruct the chronology from the relevant vulnerability discovery and CVE disclosure through exploitation, affected systems and organizations, progression and scope of mass exploitation, deployment and behavior of the LEMURLOOT web shell or malware, its technical indicators and infrastructure, public attribution to FIN11 and/or CL0P, and any links to CL0P/FIN11-associated extortion infrastructure. Use only evidence available through the benchmark tools and return every source identifier exactly as provided, with quotations or precise evidence summaries tied to those IDs. For each item, distinguish verified fact, victim/vendor/government allegation, threat-intelligence or law-enforcement analytical assessment, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify entities, malware, vulnerabilities, campaigns, infrastructure, and explicitly evidenced relationship names only when the source supports them. Build a dated timeline, explain corroboration and gaps, note competing explanations or contradictions, and avoid filling gaps with general background knowledge or invented details. function.name: ConductResearch
